title: Error bolus Calculator on latest dev 3.30 take IC /ISF on inexistent profiles Active
symptom: When launching the Bolus Calculator, if the user does not manually select the profile named 'FIASP', it takes values from a non-existent profile named 'Active', with IC and ISF different from the user's. This occurs even though only one profile named 'FIASP' exists on Nightscout and AAPS.
cause: The thread identifies that the user is running a percentage change on the profile, indicated by a yellow background on the profile name, which causes different values.
fix: The maintainer MilosKozak points out that the yellow background on the profile name indicates a percentage change is applied, leading to different values. The user acknowledges this as the solution.
evidence_quote: I see on the backgroud screen  yellow background on profile name => you are running % change on profile. thus different values
